Description: Students may not know when deposits are normally paid, how deposits are documented, or which payment requests are suspicious.
Why_It_Matters: Scammers exploit urgency by asking for a deposit, reservation fee, or first month rent before the student has verified the property and landlord.
Safe_Guidance: Do not pay before verifying the property, landlord identity, contract details, and payment account. Use traceable payment methods and keep written records.

Description: International students may not understand official waiting lists, lottery processes, university housing portals, or local housing scarcity.
Why_It_Matters: Scammers use housing shortage pressure and claims of many applicants to force fast decisions.
Safe_Guidance: Check the official university housing page and trusted housing platform rules before sending documents or money.

Description: Students may not know that subletting can require landlord, housing association, or municipality permission.
Why_It_Matters: Fake subletters exploit plausible student-to-student arrangements and avoid formal contract checks.
Safe_Guidance: Ask for written proof that subletting is permitted and verify the original tenant and address through independent channels.

Description: New arrivals may not know that video tours, remote viewings, and inability to view in person can be abused.
Why_It_Matters: Scammers hide that they do not control the property by refusing live or in-person verification.
Safe_Guidance: Prefer in-person viewing, live video calls that show the address and surroundings, or verification by a trusted local person.

Description: Students may not know how to check whether a contract, landlord name, address, and payment account fit together.
Why_It_Matters: Scammers use copied contracts, fake IDs, or mismatched bank accounts to look legitimate.
Safe_Guidance: Verify landlord identity, address, contract terms, registration possibility, and bank account ownership before signing or paying.

Description: Students may overtrust social media groups, unofficial housing pages, copied listings, or platform-like messages.
Why_It_Matters: Scammers impersonate administrators, agencies, and verified landlords to borrow credibility.
Safe_Guidance: Use official platforms when possible, stay inside platform messaging, and verify external payment links or admin claims independently.
